disclosures.title: SABIC Earnings Release Q1 2026
disclosures.body_text: SABIC announced its financial results for the first quarter of 2026: revenue of SAR 26.15 billion, EBITDA of SAR 4.15 billion and net income attributable to equity holders of the Parent of SAR 0.01 billion.
